# DSH Sidebar Scroll
简体中文
Scroll sidebar navigation, projects, and conversations together in DeepSeek Harness. As you scroll d
own, navigation moves out of view and gives projects and conversations more room. The brand, New Ses
sion button, and account footer stay fixed.
## Install
The current release targets **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1**. For DSH 0.2.1-rc.3, use plugin tag `v0.
urrent release targets **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1**. For DSH 0.2.1-rc.3, use plugin tag `v0.1.1`.
In the DSH plugin manager, install this Git source:

For DSH Desktop, use its own plugin manager so the plugin is installed into the desktop profile. Ref
resh the interface after installation. Built client files are included; installation does not need a
erface after installation. Built client files are included; installation does not need a build step.
## Behavior

- Projects lists grow with their content and share the navigation's scroll viewport.
- Workspace bro
wsers that bind DSH's section scroller keep its scroll handoff: navigation moves away before the lis
t scrolls. Older workspace builds that do not bind it retain outer scrolling and an outer scrollbar.

- Scrolling dismisses Projects conversation menus.
- Panel icons and pinning, narrow-screen drawers
, keyboard focus, and session-creation permissions follow the current official sidebar.
Projects integration uses the `.pj-root` and `.pj-list` selectors from Projects 1.0.0-local.1. Versi
ons that change those selectors need separate compatibility checks.
## Disable or remove
Deactivate or remove the **DSH Sidebar Scroll bundle** in the plugin manager, then refresh the inter
face. Restart the DSH process if the manager requires it. This removes its composition patch and res
tores the official sidebar. Disabling only the `sidebar-scroll` runtime entry leaves the bundle patc
h active and can leave the sidebar empty; re-enable that entry or deactivate the whole bundle to rec
ive and can leave the sidebar empty; re-enable that entry or deactivate the whole bundle to recover.
The bundle replaces the `ui-sidebar` presentation row while enabled. Use one sidebar-shell replaceme
nt at a time. Check compatibility before upgrading DSH: this release includes the matching sidebar c
omponent and intentionally targets one host version.
## Development
Use Node.js 24.9.0 or later:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/client.js` is committed so Git installations can use the built client directly. CI checks that
rebuilding produces the same client file.
To check the installed Desktop runtime offline, run `npm run check:host`. On Windows it locates the
usual per-user installation; for another location, use `npm run check:host -- --asar /path/to/app.as
ar`. This loads the installed renderer, shared client modules, and official workspace component in a
DOM test environment without changing a profile. It reports whether the actual workspace consumes t
he section-scroller hook or uses the outer-scroll fallback.
`npm run check:browser` checks scrolling and layout in an existing Chromium installation; set `CHROM
E_PATH` to select one. With an installed host it uses the plugin bundle and host workspace CSS; with
out one it uses the actual CSS and handoff source with layout fixtures. These checks cover legacy, b
ound-scroller, and Projects-shaped lists. CI requires Chromium with `DSH_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1`; actual
Projects business actions and GUI lifecycle remain separate integration checks.
## Release
Pushing a `vX.Y.Z` tag matching the package version reuses CI to check the build, tests, release met
adata, and installation of the packed artifact through dsh-plugin-checker with the declared DSH vers
ion. The same artifact is then published to GitHub Releases and npm. Run the Release workflow manual
ly with an existing tag to retry; an existing npm version must have the same integrity as the artifa
with an existing tag to retry; an existing npm version must have the same integrity as the artifact.
npm uses Trusted Publishing by default. For the first publication, use an npm account that owns the
`@rakan` scope and configure the repository secret `NPM_TOKEN` with permission to create this packag
e; this still publishes the artifact verified by CI. After creating the package, configure its GitHu
b Actions trusted publisher: owner `Rakanrkk`, repository `dsh-sidebar-scroll`, workflow `release.ym
l`, no environment, and allow direct `npm publish`. Remove `NPM_TOKEN` to use OIDC and complete the
first successful publication within two days of creating the configuration. GitHub Releases can publ
ish independently while npm account setup is incomplete; the npm job reports failure.
Each release includes the versioned package and an identical `dsh-sidebar-scroll.tgz` asset. Existin
g assets are verified by SHA-256 and never overwritten. The community download URL uses `releases/la
test/download/dsh-sidebar-scroll.tgz`, so normal stable releases update the download without a catal
og PR. Prereleases do not change the stable catalog entry.
The community website entry lives in awesome-dsh-plugin. Run `node scripts/update-market.mjs` to che
ck its download and description, or add `--submit` to submit changes using the authenticated GitHub
CLI. An unchanged entry creates no PR; a pending update PR is reused. A change to functionality or s
upported DSH versions can require an entry update. Set `MARKET_TOKEN` with permission to write to yo
ur fork and open an upstream PR to automate submission; otherwise, download the generated draft.
Installed-plugin update checks are separate from catalog edits: dsh-market checks npm versions or th
e chosen GitHub source. An explicitly pinned tag or tarball remains pinned. npm publication is optio
nal for the community website; the community's format-1 DSH discovery index currently requires npm m
etadata and its subsequent probe and build.
